tagline: All-in-One D2C Conversion Suite & Ready-Made Page Library
valueProposition: Replace 5 separate apps with one high-converting store OS. Includes courier pincode & COD checker, photo reviews, customer wishlist, back-in-stock alerts, product bundles, and sticky urgency ATC inside theme-matched page designs.
features: Courier Pincode & COD Delivery Checker with SLA calculation (<50ms speed)
Customer Photo Reviews & Moderation Queue with review-request emails
Frequently Bought Together Bundles & Upsell Cards
Sticky Add-To-Cart Bar with Real Inventory Urgency (no fake urgency)
howItWorks:
1. Install Shop Forge on your store in 1 click.
2. Browse 50 ready-made page and section conversion designs.
3. Add blocks directly into your active theme via Shopify Theme Editor.
4. Enable Store OS features (pincode checker, photo reviews, wishlist, bundles) with zero coding.
pricingExplanation:
Unambiguous Subscription Tiers & Order Volume Caps:
- Free: $0/mo (₹0/mo) — 5 static designs, no watermark.
- Starter: $9/mo (₹799/mo) — up to 100 orders/mo. Includes India Essentials Pack.
- Growth: $29/mo (₹2,499/mo) — up to 500 orders/mo. Includes Photo Reviews, Wishlist, Stock Alerts, Bundles & Sticky ATC.
- Scale: $59/mo (₹4,999/mo) — up to 2,000 orders/mo. Includes A/B Testing & Analytics.
- Pro: $99/mo (₹8,999/mo) — unlimited orders/mo. Includes dedicated support.
